summary: Frontend-only UI testing of Mod-Mate MVP shell completed via Playwright. All 7 routes (Landing, Dashboard, Builder, Playground, Templates, Integrations, Settings) load correctly; routing, interactive UI state (builder JSON preview, rule add/remove, action toggle, playground send/reset/companion switch, template filter+search), mobile responsive (hamburger, mobile nav strip, sidebar hidden), and unknown-route redirect to '/' all work as specified. No backend testing was requested (UI-only mock data).

issues: Companion picker dropdown uses absolute positioning with hard-coded offsets (mt-44 ml-1) which may render in an awkward position relative to the picker button on different viewports. Consider using a portal/popover or anchoring to the trigger.
'Save draft' button is a placeholder per spec (intentional), but provides no visual hint (e.g., tooltip) that it is non-functional in this UI-only pass.

critical_code_review_comments: Playground.jsx: companion-dropdown is positioned with `absolute mt-44 ml-1` which is fragile — better to use proper relative anchoring or a popover primitive.

Landing.jsx: marketing nav links use anchor hashes (#templates, #how, #integrations) which work only on '/'. From other routes these href='/#templates' actually navigate correctly because of leading '/', good.
All pages use mock data correctly; no network calls present. Files are well-scoped under /pages and /components. data-testid coverage is good and aligns with spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (55/55 functional checks pass; 3 initial 'failures' were test-selector issues, retested and confirmed working)

seed_data_creation: None — all data is static mock in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI-only pass verified. Templates grid children are not <div> — use selector `[data-testid^="template-card-"]` or `[data-testid="templates-grid"] > *` to count cards. Builder rule text appears in BOTH the chip and the JSON preview <pre>, so use `[data-testid^="rule-"]:not([data-testid$="-remove"])` for rule chip assertions to avoid strict-mode violations. All other selectors per spec work as documented.
rca of the issue: No app issues found. The 3 initial test failures were caused by overly strict Playwright selectors (`text=` matched both chip and JSON pre; `> div` did not match TemplateCard root element). After fixing selectors in a re-test, all features verified working.
